text: A Song{H7892} of degrees{H4609}. Behold, bless{H1288}{(H8761)} ye the LORD{H3068}, all ye servants{H5650} of the LORD{H3068}, which by night{H3915} stand{H5975}{(H8802)} in the house{H1004} of the LORD{H3068}.
